name: Maon
overview: Maon was a male member of the tribe of Judah, uniquely identified as the son of Shammai. His mention in Scripture is brief and primarily genealogical, emphasizing his place within the Judahite lineage. There are no additional notes or narrative details about his life or actions.
namesAndTitles: The name Maon is a proper name meaning "dwelling." It is not indicated that this name was given by God. This meaning reflects a common Hebrew name form but does not carry specific theological significance within the biblical text.
familyAndRelationships: Maon is explicitly identified as the son of Shammai and the father of Bethzur. These relationships situate him within a family line recorded in the tribe of Judah, but Scripture does not provide further familial details beyond these connections.
scriptureSignificance: Maon's significance lies in his role within the genealogical records of Judah, serving as a link in the ancestral line that preserves the heritage of God's chosen tribe. His mention in 1 Chronicles 2:45 contributes to the biblical emphasis on lineage and God's providential preservation of His people through successive generations. Although not prominent in narrative events, Maon's inclusion underscores the faithfulness of God in maintaining the covenant line.
